title: Cutting Costs
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Bassoon over honky-tonk piano, accordion, pizzicato bass and a sad trombone -- deflated rather than tragic, which is exactly what running out of money feels like. It occupies the low-energy/negative-valence corner that nothing else did: bleak WITHOUT being tense, so it never competes with a war. If the treasury collapses during a war, March to the Death still wins, and that is the right order of priorities. Restricted to game because a bankruptcy theme has no meaning outside one.
